_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'RESPONSIBILITY ASSIGNMENT MATRIX' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.06.04.

f01_Responsible_R_Definition.label: Responsible (R) Definition
f01_Responsible_R_Definition.guidance: Definition: The role assigned to do the work and complete the activity deliverable.

f02_Accountable_A_Definition.label: Accountable (A) Definition
f02_Accountable_A_Definition.guidance: Definition: The single role with ultimate ownership, decision authority, and sign-off approval.

f03_Consulted_C_Definition.label: Consulted (C) Definition
f03_Consulted_C_Definition.guidance: Definition: Subject matter experts providing vital two-way input and technical guidance.

f04_Informed_I_Definition.label: Informed (I) Definition
f04_Informed_I_Definition.guidance: Definition: Stakeholders kept updated on progress, milestones, and decisions via one-way communication.

f05_WBS_Deliverable_and_Assigned_RACI_Co.label: WBS Deliverable and Assigned RACI Codes
f05_WBS_Deliverable_and_Assigned_RACI_Co.guidance: Tabular mapping assigning explicit R, A, C, and I roles for each major WBS work package.

f06_Role_Coverage_and_Work_Distribution.label: Role Coverage and Work Distribution
f06_Role_Coverage_and_Work_Distribution.guidance: Verification that every activity has exactly one Accountable role and at least one Responsible role.

f07_Single_Accountability_Governance_Rul.label: Single Accountability Governance Rule
f07_Single_Accountability_Governance_Rul.guidance: Mandatory policy prohibiting multiple Accountable (A) assignments per deliverable to prevent diffusion of responsibility.

f08_Escalation_and_Conflict_Resolution_P.label: Escalation and Conflict Resolution Protocol
f08_Escalation_and_Conflict_Resolution_P.guidance: Process for resolving role overlaps, gaps, and decision deadlocks across project leads.
